projects.title: Real-time review sentiment pipeline
projects.blurb: Reviews stream through Kafka into Spark, get a DistilBERT sentiment label, land in MongoDB and Elasticsearch, and show up in Kibana. The 82-minute build video is the most watched thing I've published.

projects.title: ELK log management with lifecycle tiers
projects.blurb: A multi-node Elasticsearch, Logstash and Kibana setup with hot, cold and frozen index lifecycle tiers, documented step by step.

projects.title: Streaming API records into Cassandra
projects.blurb: Airflow pulls user records from an API into Kafka, and Spark Structured Streaming processes them into Cassandra. Everything runs in Docker Compose.

projects.title: Reddit data platform
projects.blurb: Reddit API data moves through NiFi and Airflow into MinIO and Hive, is queried with Trino, and ends up in Superset and Tableau dashboards.

projects.title: One-time code delivery pipeline
projects.blurb: Airflow writes email addresses to a three-broker Kafka cluster, loads them into Cassandra and MongoDB, checks the email and one-time code in both, and sends the code by email, Slack and Discord.
